description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'ListFloatItem' for a custom field type 'list_float' that stores floating-point numbers, including schema, property definitions, validation, and form settings.

classes.name: ListFloatItem
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing a field type for storing floating-point numbers as list items.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the data property 'value' as a float, required for the field.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Provides the database schema for storing the float value.

methods.name: allowedValuesDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of allowed values, including HTML tags permitted.

methods.name: extractAllowedValues
methods.description: Processes and disambiguates allowed float values from a string.

methods.name: validateAllowedValue
methods.description: Validates that a value is numeric (integer or decimal).

methods.name: simplifyAllowedValues
methods.description: Simplifies nested allowed values, casting values to float and string keys.

methods.name: castAllowedValue
methods.description: Casts a value to float for storage.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for storage settings, particularly for allowed values with number step and type.
